title: Send package, buyer sets timing
description: Send the package, keep Priya involved and leave the review timing to Marco.
rationale: Marco said he cannot commit to a date before his team reads the documents, and Priya remains the commercial point of contact.

evidence_refs.quote: Before we can sign off on the EU rollout we'll need your SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary.
I can't commit to a review date until our team has read them.

subject: Re: Expansion to EU teams

full_action_artifact.subject: Re: Expansion to EU teams
full_action_artifact.body:
Hi Marco,

Thanks for jumping in. Attached are our SOC2 Type II report and the latest pen-test summary. Happy to set up time with our security team once you've reviewed - whatever timing works for you and Priya.

Best,
Dana

five_questions.what_changed: Marco Silva, Head of Security, joined the thread and asked for the SOC2 Type II report and the pen-test summary.
five_questions.why_state_changed: Marco wrote to us first-party in the email of 2026-09-29, and the buying group had no security member before.
five_questions.what_remains_unknown: When Marco's team can review; he said he cannot commit to a date until they have read the documents.
five_questions.prior_knowledge_applies: K17: keep the active champion involved when a new stakeholder enters during an expansion.
five_questions.why_next_action: Sending the package and leaving the timing to Marco respects his stated constraint and moves the review forward.
